design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast Modular Command (Ref: Dribbble CRM Dashboard)

font_system.rules: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) on headings >= 20px. Use font-mono for financial metrics, KPI values, streak counts, and timestamp badges.

sidebar.style: Clean persistent background, subtle 1px border, expandable section groups

main_dashboard.grid_mode: Bento Grid System (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5)
widgets: Daily Briefing Banner + AI Next Action (col-span-full md:col-span-8)
Daily Execution Score Progress Ring & Streaks (col-span-full md:col-span-4)

component_styling_rules.cards: Subtle border (border-border), rounded-xl, quiet shadow-sm, crisp bg-card, p-5 to p-6 padding
component_styling_rules.kanban: Drag-and-drop / click-to-move columns with stage counts, deal values, lead tags, and quick-edit slide-over drawer
component_styling_rules.progress_ring: SVG circle with animated stroke-dashoffset, inner percentage + score level label
component_styling_rules.command_menu: Cmd+K modal overlay with instant filter for actions, navigation, CRM records, and tasks
component_styling_rules.contact_drawer: Slide-over sheet (right side, 440px width) containing contact details, interactions log, notes, and follow-up scheduler

features: Daily Execution Score (0 - 100% composite of top priorities, habits, shutdown)
Leveling System (e.g., Level 12 Scale Architect) based on actual activity
Daily Shutdown Ritual (End-of-day reflect, clear inbox, set tomorrow's top 3)

motion_and_micro_interactions.list_item: staggered entrance variants opacity 0 to 1, y 10 to 0
motion_and_micro_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; disable parallax/heavy transforms if active

testing_and_qa.rule: CRITICAL: Every interactive button, link, form input, tab, modal trigger, card, and metric display MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.
